param: Ψ Total constant recruitment into adult susceptible population (all groups combined). Text denotes constant recruitment C; equations use Ψ.
θ Proportion of recruits that are men (text: h).
γ Proportion of men that are heterosexual (text: c). Thus homosexual men proportion among men is (1-γ).
μ Natural mortality rate (estimated from life expectancy 77.3 years: μ = 1/77.3 ≈ 0.0129).
α Departure rate from infected (untreated) compartments (text: a). Governs leaving I compartments into treatment or AIDS classes.
p Proportion of infected individuals who initiate ART upon leaving infected class (text: proportion initially treated).
δ AIDS development rate in treated individuals due to ART resistance/treatment failure (text uses d for this; equations use δ).
d AIDS-induced mortality rate (average survival with AIDS ~3 years: d = 1/3 ≈ 0.3333).
λ_h Force of infection for susceptible homosexual men (infection via contact with infected homosexual men).
λ_m Force of infection on women due to infected heterosexual men (heterosexual transmission).
λ_hw Force of infection on women due to infected homosexual men (bisexual contact: homosexual men → women).
λ_w Force of infection on heterosexual men due to infected women (heterosexual transmission).
λ_hm Force of infection on heterosexual men due to infected homosexual men (bisexual contact: homosexual men → heterosexual men).
Ψ_h Recruitment into susceptible homosexual men: Ψθ(1-γ).
Ψ_w Recruitment into susceptible women: Ψ(1-θ).
Ψ_m Recruitment into susceptible heterosexual men: Ψθγ.
Inflow_T Total inflow to Treated (ART) from all infected classes, as in equation for T.
Inflow_A_from_I Total inflow to AIDS from all infected classes not initiating ART, as in equation for A.
